component.name: M3UTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() path = m.top.url if path = "" then m.top.error = "Playlist data path is not configured." return end if
m.top.batchIndex = 0 m.top.batchAck = 0 m.top.complete = false indexText = ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/data/channels_index.json") if indexText <> "" loadPlaylistShards(indexText) return end if
legacyText = ReadAsciiFile(path) if legacyText = "" m.top.error = "Playlist data is missing or too large in this package. Rebuild it in the MasterChief Roku Builder and install the new ZIP." return end if legacyChannels = ParseJson(legacyText) if legacyChannels = invalid or type(legacyChannels) <> "roArray" m.top.error = "Playlist data is not a valid channel list. Rebuild the Roku package in MasterChief." return end if channels = normalizeChannels(legacyChannels) if channels.count() = 0 m.top.error = "No playable channels were found in the packaged playlist." return end if if not sendChannelsBatch(channels) then return m.top.complete = true end sub
sub loadPlaylistShards(indexText as String) playlistIndex = ParseJson(indexText) if playlistIndex = invalid m.top.error = "The packaged playlist index is invalid. Rebuild the Roku package in MasterChief." return end if if type(playlistIndex.shards) <> "roArray" m.top.error = "The packaged playlist index is invalid. Rebuild the Roku package in MasterChief." return end if shardNamePattern = CreateObject("roRegex", "^channels_[0-9]+\.json$", "i") totalChannels = 0 for each shardName in playlistIndex.shards if type(shardName) <> "roString" and type(shardName) <> "String" m.top.error = "The packaged playlist index contains an invalid shard name." return end if if not shardNamePattern.IsMatch(shardName) m.top.error = "The packaged playlist index contains an unsafe shard name." return end if shardPath = "pkg:/data/" + shardName shardText = ReadAsciiFile(shardPath) if shardText = "" m.top.error = "A playlist data shard is empty or missing (" + shardName + "). Rebuild the Roku package in MasterChief." return end if parsed = ParseJson(shardText) if parsed = invalid or type(parsed) <> "roArray" m.top.error = "A playlist data shard is not valid JSON (" + shardName + "). Rebuild the Roku package in MasterChief." return end if channels = normalizeChannels(parsed) if channels.count() > 0 if not sendChannelsBatch(channels) then return totalChannels = totalChannels + channels.count() end if end for if totalChannels = 0 m.top.error = "No playable channels were found in the packaged playlist." return end if m.top.complete = true end sub
function normalizeChannels(parsed as Object) as Object channels = [] for each item in parsed if type(item) <> "roAssociativeArray" then continue for url = item.url if url = invalid or url = "" then continue for name = item.title if name = invalid or name = "" then name = "Channel " + stri(channels.count() + 1).trim() grp = item.group if grp = invalid or grp = "" then grp = "Uncategorized" logo = item.logo if logo = invalid then logo = "" streamFormat = item.stream_format if streamFormat = invalid or streamFormat = "" then streamFormat = inferStreamFormat(url) end if channel = {name: name, url: url, group: grp, logo: logo, stream_format: streamFormat} if item.http_headers <> invalid and type(item.http_headers) = "roAssociativeArray" channel.http_headers = item.http_headers end if if item.category <> invalid then channel.category = item.category else channel.category = grp end if if item.tvg_id <> invalid then channel.tvg_id = item.tvg_id if item.duration <> invalid then channel.duration = item.duration if item.metadata <> invalid and type(item.metadata) = "roAssociativeArray" channel.metadata = item.metadata end if channels.push(channel) end for return channels end function
function sendChannelsBatch(channels as Object) as Boolean nextBatch = m.top.batchIndex + 1 m.top.channelsJson = FormatJson(channels) m.top.batchIndex = nextBatch for attempt = 1 to 300 if m.top.batchAck >= nextBatch then return true sleep(10) end for m.top.error = "Roku did not finish indexing playlist data. Try rebuilding with fewer entries." return false end function
function inferStreamFormat(url as String) as String normalized = LCase(url) if Instr(1, normalized, "output=ts") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "format=ts") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "output=mp2ts") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "format=mp2ts") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "container=mp2ts") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "stream_format=mp2ts") > 0 return "mp2ts" end if if Instr(1, normalized, "output=m3u8") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "format=hls") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "output=hls") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "container=m3u8") > 0 or Instr(1, normalized, "stream_format=hls") > 0 return "hls" end if queryStart = Instr(1, normalized, "?") if queryStart > 0 then normalized = Left(normalized, queryStart - 1) fragmentStart = Instr(1, normalized, "#") if fragmentStart > 0 then normalized = Left(normalized, fragmentStart - 1) if Right(normalized, 5) = ".m3u8" then return "hls" if Right(normalized, 3) = ".ts" then return "mp2ts" if Right(normalized, 4) = ".mp4" or Right(normalized, 4) = ".m4v" then return "mp4" if Right(normalized, 4) = ".mkv" then return "mkv" if Right(normalized, 4) = ".mov" then return "mov" if Right(normalized, 4) = ".mp3" then return "mp3" if Right(normalized, 4) = ".mpd" then return "dash" if Right(normalized, 4) = ".avi" or Right(normalized, 4) = ".m3u" then return "unsupported" return "hls" end function
